# Country scope (v14.5 Secretariats 2.0). Managed by the 11-Province Imperial Ledger: 6 inner, 3 frontier, Yunnan (LNG), Zhengdong (KOR).

    country_exists = c:CHI

        is_subject_type = oe_yp_xingsheng

    }
}

# Country scope = CHI (v14.5 Secretariats 2.0). Three-Commission Reform (改三司) unlocked by Yuan Restoration or Grand Debate .41.

        has_global_variable = oe_sit2_yr_ended
        has_global_variable = oe_yp_sansi_unlocked
    }
}

# Any scope. The Yuan has fallen (Y2), read from vanilla state only. True when CHI no longer exists, or CHI is held by a
# Red Turban leader (vanilla rtr_become_china_effect sets rtr_is_new_china, then red_turban_rebellions.101 turns the old
# Yuan into YUA and the leader forms CHI_f) or by any country other than the Yuan's own (global var oe_yp_yuan, stored by
# the first check: the country object keeps its identity when its tag changes),
# or the Middle Kingdom no longer exists (the case in which vanilla sends red_turban_rebellions.105 "End of the Mandate"), or
# another country leads it (rebel mandate .100, flavor_chi.33 "The Northern Yuan", a mandate-of-heaven war).
# oe_yp_fall_reason (script values) gives the first matching reason, in this order.
oe_yp_yuan_fallen = {
    OR = {
        NOT = { country_exists = c:CHI }
        AND = {
            country_exists = c:CHI
            OR = {
                c:CHI = { has_variable = rtr_is_new_china }
                AND = { has_global_variable = oe_yp_yuan NOT = { global_var:oe_yp_yuan ?= c:CHI } }
                NOT = { exists = international_organization:middle_kingdom }
                NOT = { international_organization:middle_kingdom ?= { leader_country = c:CHI } }
            }
        }
    }
}
